producerKind.description: A coding agent or reviewing model produced the result.
A deterministic tool or analyzer produced the result without model judgement.
A person produced or attested the result directly.
The result was migrated from a legacy contract and its original producer kind could not be established with certainty.
The producer kind could not be determined. Never defaulted to agent.

evidenceStatus.description: The full evidence expected by the review profile was collected.
Some but not all expected evidence was collected.
No evidence could be collected for this observation.

assessment.description: The evidence establishes that the subject meets the aspect.
The evidence raises a qualified concern short of a failure.
The evidence establishes that the subject does not meet the aspect.
The evidence does not support a pass or fail determination.
The aspect does not apply to this subject.
The aspect was not evaluated for this observation.

change.description: The comparison shows the subject improved.
The comparison shows the subject regressed.
The comparison shows both improvement and regression.
The comparison shows no material change.
No comparable prior observation exists to measure a delta.
The comparison could not determine direction.

decision.description: Policy permits proceeding but records a warning.
Policy defers the decision to a later or human review.

lifecycle.description: The issue is unresolved and awaiting action.
The issue is known and its risk was explicitly accepted.
The issue was determined not to be real.
The issue was fixed and verified resolved.

evidenceKind.description: A located excerpt of reviewed source code.
A measurement captured from a running system.
Structured output from a deterministic tool, such as JSON or SARIF.
A stored artifact reference, such as a report or log file.
A document reference, such as a specification or guideline.
A statement attested by a person.
